# cImp built-in audit tools — pre-migration golden (V38 design live-verify 7)
#
# Generated by `audit::golden`. Every line below is behaviour a user or a model
# can observe: the argv a scan spawns, the metadata that gates it, the verdict a
# canned run produces, and the umbrella report a model reads. Phase E changes how
# these fourteen tools are DEFINED; this document is what says it changed nothing
# they DO.
#
# root   = /proj/root
# report = /tmp/cimp-audit/report.sarif
# every `done` line reports a fixed 1234 ms so the document carries no clock.
